criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: A real drawn image on every frame and a genuine value arc (measured 77.8, 77.5, 51.0, 34.1, 45.9, 20.8, 77.5, 43.5, 13.0; spread 64.8), with frames 1, 6 and 9 screenshot-worthy. The accent genuinely migrates margin-tick to tablet-pool to floor-patch to three patches, absent on 2/4/5/7/9, a designed argument in colour. Nine distinct layouts. Held back: at 432px frame 3's classroom crowd merges into a dark mass and the blue tablet pool nearly disappears, and frame 4's origin scene reads murky; frame 5's hero word carries a heavy extrusion the render QA reads as a strikethrough edge (marked data-overlap-ok).

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Exemplary, and the deck's spine. Every numeral traces: award id 2539663 (c22), grant number 15PBJA-23-GG-06172-NTCP (c19) and FY 2026 = $749,999.00 (c24) on frame 7, October 1st 2026 and September 30th 2029 (c27, c25) on frame 9, four courses (c33) on frame 3. The two money strings never share a frame and $750,000 appears nowhere. The two funders are never blurred, and the unreached DOJ record is drawn as an empty LIT ruled field labelled NOT REACHED THIS RUN a4 rather than faked.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns what happened, who, and where: UTA in Arlington, an NSF grant, an AI tutor that hints instead of answering, the same system tested with Fort Worth police on de-escalation, two federal funders, and that nothing is graded because the award starts October 1st. But there is no actionable next step for a reader, which the deck is honest about on frame 9, and no county is drawn (Tarrant deliberately absent, a2).

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe. It builds room-one to origin to method, then the real turn at frame 6 lands hard because it is the identical camera to frame 3 with the light inverted, so the reader feels the second room before arguing it. Frames 7-8 pay it off and frame 9 closes honestly with the accent absent. Nothing reads cuttable.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Spare, plain and on register: 'It was built to not tell you.', 'The courses do not change.', 'Two agencies pay for this.' No boosterism, no doom, place names carry the region. But it is a little flat and wire-service outside the place names.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Genuinely fresh palette and structure: a cool, mid-value pale stock deliberately breaks the near-black habit of seven of the last nine decks, the two-rooms/one-mark spine is new, and the opening move is a close-crop of a physical page. One familiar move: the instrument, reading the NSF award abstract against the university's own release, is the same as carousel 11 eighteen days ago.

one_sentence_fix: Lift the figure-to-ground separation on frames 3 and 4 so the classroom crowd and the origin table scene read as separable people at 432px instead of a dark mass, which is the one place the feed thumb loses the image the full render carries.
